summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of FieldDesk Dispatch page (/field-service/dispatch?demo=1). All 14 features tested successfully. The three-panel layout, navigation, product catalog, ProductDetail view, locked features, and context-aware filtering all work as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: DEMO MODE badge (fixed position, z-index:50) overlaps with Shop toggle button in header, causing click interception. Users can still click the Shop toggle but automated tests require force=True.

action_items: Consider adjusting DemoModeBadge position or z-index to avoid overlapping with Shop toggle button (optional - low priority)
seed_data_creation: None required - demo mode uses hardcoded values
context_for_next_testing_agent: All FieldDesk Dispatch features tested and working. The page uses inline CSS styles with GitHub dark aesthetic. Demo mode sets userIndustry='trades' and hasFieldDesk=false. TalentPipeline fetches from Supabase edge functions but returns empty in demo mode (expected). Cookie consent banner may appear at bottom - dismiss with OK button.
